sections.title: Short Title and Citation
sections.brief: This compilation is the Codex of the Mages' Guild, cited C.C.D. State who may cite it in filings. Dry.

sections.title: Enacting Authority; Autumnwood Accords Desk
sections.brief: The Accords Desk issues this title. Conservators and Innovators both sit. Neither may pretend the other does not exist.

sections.title: How to Read This Codex
sections.brief: Shall, may, must, Quiet List, reserved, see also. A reader who skips definitions is still bound. Trip the impatient.

sections.title: Persons Bound
sections.brief: Members, apprentices, temporary mouths, constructs holding a quill, guests who cast inside a Guild hall. Mike is not a person bound. Grime is not a Guild office.

sections.title: Relation to Other Law
sections.brief: Iron Mandate is rival law, not this title. Diet acts are not Guild stamps. Wario Coin is not tender. Heartstone talk is speech until surveyed.

sections.title: Definitions
sections.brief: Define caster, value, material alteration, transfiguration, disclosure, familiar, pocket, Quiet List, Paradox Trial. Numbered terms. Boring on purpose.

sections.title: Construction; Aggregation of Conduct
sections.brief: Fragmentation of conduct shall not prevent a finding of violation. Same rule as the filed photo.

sections.title: Effective Date; Savings
sections.brief: Prior Accords remain. Dead citations in Part XIV do not revive repealed schemes.

sections.title: Seals, Stamps, and What Is Not a Seal
sections.brief: Garlic bread on a map is not a seal. A concussed unnamed pilot is not a certifying officer.

sections.title: Reserved Catchlines
sections.brief: How reserved sections work. A blank is still a place in the book.

sections.title: Guild Offices Named
sections.brief: Accords Desk, Clerk, Conservator chair, Innovator chair. No new characters.

sections.title: Who May Speak for the Guild
sections.brief: Temporary mouths expire. A familiar's nod is not a speech unless the familiar is listed.

sections.title: Quorum of the Desk
sections.brief: One Conservator and one Innovator, or a clerk and a headache.

sections.title: Records of Speech
sections.brief: Spoken votes that are not filed are rumors. File before bragging.

sections.title: Conflict of Interest in Casting
sections.brief: A member may not stamp their own transfiguration of inventory.

sections.title: Delegation to Clerks
sections.brief: Clerks may refuse a stamp for incompleteness without a duel.

sections.title: Foreign Halls and Courtesy
sections.brief: A stamp from another hall is evidence, not law, until recorded.

sections.title: Emergency Sitting
sections.brief: Unscheduled weather is not by itself an emergency sitting.

sections.title: Licensure Required
sections.brief: No public casting for value without a current license.

sections.title: Apprentice Limits
sections.brief: An apprentice may fetch, not bind. Ink that recants is not a master's signature.

sections.title: Temporary Mouths
sections.brief: Duration, midnight rule, bags of holding.

sections.title: Suspension and Lapse
sections.brief: Lapse is not a Paradox Trial. It is paperwork.

sections.title: Guest Casters
sections.brief: A guest who charges a fee is not a guest.

sections.title: Constructs That Hold a Quill
sections.brief: Service of process on a construct. Swords do not receive mail.

sections.title: Schedules of Arts
sections.brief: Schedule A ordinary, B restricted, C Quiet List. Do not reciting C in taverns.

sections.title: Necromancy; Unsanctioned Arts
sections.brief: Forbidden unless a numbered permit. Innovators still file.

sections.title: Quiet List Procedure
sections.brief: How an art is listed without a public catalogue.

sections.title: Reclassification
sections.brief: Moving B to A is not a party.

sections.title: Research Copies of Quiet Items
sections.brief: Copies are still Quiet. Talking about them is not.

sections.title: Research Permits
sections.brief: Form, fee, who signs.

sections.title: Pocket Dimensions as Labs
sections.brief: Hours inside a pocket are still hours for the other party.

sections.title: Borrowed Hours; Interest in Time
sections.brief: Time-stop during settlement is still time.

sections.title: Specimen Custody
sections.brief: A petrified monster is inventory, not a trophy, until released.

sections.title: Unauthorized Titan Growth
sections.brief: Growth magic in a street is field use, not research, even if someone later studies it.

sections.title: Field Casting for Value
sections.brief: Public safety distance, notice to non-casters.

sections.title: Unscheduled Weather
sections.brief: Calling weather for agricultural advantage. Insurance does not cover weather you called.

sections.title: Corridor Courtesy After an Explosion
sections.brief: Who files first. Who sweeps.

sections.title: Healing Offered as Consideration
sections.brief: Unlicensed healing sold as a contract term.

sections.title: Love Philtre and Undue Influence
sections.brief: A philtre is not consent.

sections.title: Contracts with Non-Casters
sections.brief: Plain language. Illusion of a signature is not a signature. Illusion of a fee is still a fee.

sections.title: Familiars as Agents
sections.brief: Vicarious casting. Strike by familiar.

sections.title: Geas as an Unconscionable Term
sections.brief: A geas to be reasonable is not a defined term.

sections.title: Construct Labor; Minimum Ward
sections.brief: Wards, rest, who is paid.

sections.title: Summoned Notary
sections.brief: Form requirements. A summoned notary who vanishes mid-stamp.

sections.title: Evidence Generally
sections.brief: What a filing must contain.

sections.title: Scrying of Closed Books
sections.brief: Warrant. Spoliation even if nothing was taken.

sections.title: Memory Charm as Spoliation
sections.brief: Forgetting is not a defense if you paid for the forgetting.

sections.title: Simulacrum Testimony
sections.brief: A copy may not swear for the original.

sections.title: Clone as Duplicate Claimant
sections.brief: One claim. The later body files an amendment.

sections.title: Discipline; Range of Sanctions
sections.brief: From fee to seal to pocket-prison. Paradox Trial named.

sections.title: Paradox Trial Procedure
sections.brief: Peers, record, no street duel unless scheduled.

sections.title: Seal of Silence; Duration and Review
sections.brief: How long a mouth stays quiet.

sections.title: Duel Stakes Converted to Fees
sections.brief: If they insist on a duel, the Desk still invoices.

sections.title: Pocket-Prison Procedure
sections.brief: Who holds the key. Visiting hours are a rumor.

sections.title: Duty to File Before Casting
sections.brief: If value, composition, or risk will move, file first.

sections.title: Reporting of Material Enchantments
sections.brief: Thresholds. Late reports accrue per sunrise in the caster's original time zone.

sections.title: Record Retention
sections.brief: Seven years or one geological age, whichever the clerk finds funnier.

sections.title: Identify Fees; Who Pays
sections.brief: The person who asked. Not the Desk.

sections.title: False Provenance of Relics
sections.brief: A story is not a chain of title.

sections.title: Financial Fraud and Manipulation Generally
sections.brief: General prohibition. Cross-ref later 1001 sections.

sections.title: Prohibited Spells in Financial Markets
sections.brief: Named classes. Quiet List stays quiet.

sections.title: Valuation After Alteration
sections.brief: Who assays. Petrified inventory is still inventory.

sections.title: Illusion-Based Fraud
sections.brief: Illusion of goods, of price, of a buyer.

sections.title: Material Alteration of Traded Goods
sections.brief: MATCH THE FILED PHOTO: aggregation; permissible transfiguration; disclosure; burden; cross-refs; historical annotations C.C.D. 6125 / 7355 / 10155.

sections.title: Endowments and Gifts of Magical Assets
sections.brief: A hat that later bills the wearer is an endowment. Catchline from the photo.

sections.title: Disclosure of Composition, Value, and Risk
sections.brief: Full and accurate. True in a language the buyer does not speak is not full.

sections.title: Lead-to-Gold; Reporting Threshold
sections.brief: Lead remains lead for tax until the assay desk agrees.

sections.title: Polymorph of Coinage
sections.brief: Shape is not denomination.

sections.title: Invisibility of Liens
sections.brief: A hidden lien is still a lien. An invisible one is a violation.

sections.title: Wish Used to Rewrite a Filed Return
sections.brief: A wish does not rewrite the stamp.

sections.title: Wario Coin; Non-Recognition
sections.brief: Private tender. Points even less so. Cite only to refuse.

sections.title: Bag of Holding as Off-Books Vault
sections.brief: Off-books is still books if a clerk can smell it.

sections.title: Secured Transactions in Bound Objects
sections.brief: Collateral that can walk away.

sections.title: Layered Transfiguration Schemes
sections.brief: Read as one scheme if a reasonable toad would be confused.

sections.title: Gifts That Later Move
sections.brief: A gift with a remaining geas is not a gift.

sections.title: Relics; Chain of Title
sections.brief: Provenance, Quiet List relics.

sections.title: Curse as Warranty Disclaimer
sections.brief: A curse is not 'as is' unless disclosed.

sections.title: Blessing of a Competing Vendor
sections.brief: A blessing sold against a rival is advertising, then fraud if it binds.

sections.title: Transit Stamps
sections.brief: Planar instability surcharge. Archie-related invoices are not a defense.

sections.title: Planar Tolls
sections.brief: Evasion. Corridor courtesy.

sections.title: Extraterritorial Casting into a Diet Chamber
sections.brief: Do not. File a letter instead.

sections.title: Cartography Sold as a License to Raid
sections.brief: One-T mountain. A map is a map. It is not a permit.

sections.title: Schedule of Fees
sections.brief: Named amounts in Guild marks. No Wario Coin.

sections.title: Penalties; Sunrise Accrual
sections.brief: Original time zone, not the pocket's.

sections.title: Appeals
sections.brief: Desk, then Paradox Trial, then nowhere useful.

sections.title: Who May Inspect
sections.brief: Clerks, named officers. Not a crowd.

sections.title: Historical Annotations; Form
sections.brief: How to write C.C.D. numbers, MR pages, weekdays.

sections.title: Dead Citations
sections.brief: A repealed section may be cited as history, not as a permit.

sections.title: Savings Against the Iron Mandate
sections.brief: This title does not repeal itself because an Empire shouted.
